note: Draft — best-guess from onboarding data. Users confirm and correct in Phase 1b.

triggerPatterns.pattern: support_issue_volume rising 3+ consecutive weeks AND resolution_time stable
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Consider whether support team can absorb continued growth — resolution typically lags volume by 2–3 weeks.

triggerPatterns.pattern: bug_impact elevated while feature_adoption_trend is flat or declining
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Weigh stability and quality work against new features on the near-term roadmap.

triggerPatterns.pattern: support_issue_volume rising 3+ consecutive weeks AND resolution_time stable
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Consider whether support team can absorb continued growth — resolution typically lags volume by 2–3 weeks.

triggerPatterns.pattern: sla_compliance trending down while support_issue_volume is high
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Evaluate capacity (hire, outsource, or process change) before SLA risk becomes customer-visible.

triggerPatterns.pattern: pipeline_value growing but prospects or calls_per_week not keeping pace
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Check whether growth is concentrated in existing accounts vs true market expansion — adjust GTM focus if needed.

triggerPatterns.pattern: win_rate stable or improving with healthy pipeline_value
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Expansion timing may be favourable; validate with segment-level win_rate before committing.

triggerPatterns.pattern: pipeline_value up materially while win_rate falls
triggerPatterns.recommendation: May indicate team at capacity or poor qualification — review rep load and stage conversion before adding headcount.

triggerPatterns.pattern: support_issue_volume rising while csat declines
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Prioritize scaling or workflow fixes — customer sentiment often moves after volume stress.

triggerPatterns.pattern: resolution_time lengthening with flat or rising issue volume
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Backlog and burnout risk; model headcount or tooling needs against projected volume.

triggerPatterns.pattern: churn_leading_indicator worsening while win_rate softens
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Signal to revisit ICP, packaging, or onboarding — PMF stress often shows in both acquisition and retention.

triggerPatterns.pattern: Strong pipeline_value and win_rate with churn_leading_indicator under control
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Narrative for investors is easier to defend; still document cohort and segment breakdowns.

triggerPatterns.pattern: pipeline_value strong but churn_leading_indicator deteriorating
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Address retention story before fundraising — investors will weight leading churn signals heavily.

triggerPatterns.pattern: inactive_pharmacy_rate > 15%
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Review inactive accounts for common patterns — potential churn risk.

triggerPatterns.pattern: shift_utilisation declining across multiple accounts
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Proactive outreach playbook: usage drop often precedes renewal risk.

triggerPatterns.pattern: Renewal window approaching with low shift_utilisation or rising inactive_pharmacy_rate
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Lead with value recovery (usage, training) before price or expansion conversations.

triggerPatterns.pattern: jobs_posted spike with uneven shift_utilisation
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Prepare talking points on filling roles and balancing supply and demand on the account.

triggerPatterns.pattern: signups concentrated in one segment with weaker adoption_by_segment elsewhere
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Tailor onboarding tracks by segment instead of a single generic path.

triggerPatterns.pattern: inactive_pharmacy_rate > 15%
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Review inactive accounts for common patterns — potential churn risk.

triggerPatterns.pattern: shifts flat or down while inactive_pharmacy_rate rises
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Escalate to success leadership — may need executive sponsor or success plan.

triggerPatterns.pattern: prospect_opportunity_size materially above avg_deal_size for similar accounts
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Flag for commercial follow-up — whitespace may justify land-and-expand motion.

triggerPatterns.pattern: support_issue_volume rising for the account with resolution_time stretching vs team baseline
triggerPatterns.recommendation: Consider executive escalation or dedicated support path — pattern may indicate systemic issue on the account.
